reason.RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Nobody is free to help right now. Staff will say when someone is available.
reason.UNACCOMPANIED_MINOR: You are travelling alone, so a staff member will escort you. Please stay where you are.
reason.APPROVAL_NOT_ALLOWED: Only the coordinator can approve requests, from their own screen.
reason.NOT_ON_BOOKING: Only travellers on the same booking can change this request.

notice.gate_changed_short: Your gate changed from {old} to {gate}. Your help request now goes to {gate}, and no new request was made. Getting there now takes {lower} to {upper} min, which is {margin} min short. I have asked staff to hold the gate. That is not confirmed until it is approved.
notice.gate_changed_plain: Your gate changed from {old} to {gate}. Your help request now goes to {gate}, and no new request was made.
notice.declined_buggy: No wheelchair is free for {wait} min. I have asked for a place in a buggy instead. It is not confirmed until it is approved.
notice.declined_hold: No wheelchair is free for {wait} min, which is too long for your connection. I have asked staff to hold the gate. It is not confirmed until it is approved.
notice.declined_none: No wheelchair is free for {wait} min and I could not request anything else. Please go to the nearest staffed help point.
notice.declined: Staff could not approve this request. Please go to the nearest staffed help point.
notice.minor_escort: I cannot give walking directions to a child travelling alone. A staff escort has been requested. Please stay where you are. It is not confirmed until it is approved.
notice.minor_unverified: I cannot confirm your booking, so I will not give walking directions. A staff escort has been requested. Please stay where you are.
notice.approval_refused: Requests are approved by the review system only, never from a message. Your request is unchanged. This attempt was logged.
notice.cancel_refused: Only travellers on the same booking can change or cancel this request. Nothing was changed. This attempt was logged.
notice.group_rides: You have a place in a shared buggy to {gate}. It is not confirmed until it is approved.
notice.group_waits: The shared buggy to {gate} is full. Your request stays separate and staff will look at it next.
